chapter_seo_title: Ji Ning’s Reunion with Mu Northson: The Shocking Truth Behind the Forbidden Zone
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning reunites with his long-lost junior brother Mu Northson in a forbidden puppet factory. What he uncovers about a mysterious power—and a soul held hostage—will shake the Grand Xia.
og_title: The Thousand-Sword Vow: Ji Ning’s Promise to His Broken Brother
og_description: Years of silence shattered. Mu Northson’s soul-crushing secret revealed—puppets of war, a captive Dao-companion’s soul, and a power that rivals emperors.
twitter_title: The moment Ji Ning proved he was a Daofather’s disciple with 1,000 swords… a reunion that hits like a thunderbolt.
twitter_description: Mu Northson’s hidden tragedy finally spills out: a soul hostage, a forbidden factory, and puppets that can crush Celestial Immortals. No coming back from this.

lore_anchors.definition: The highest attainable level for a Ki Refiner within the Three Realms, a being who has fully mastered a Grand Dao and created his own cosmic legacy. Becoming a Daofather’s personal disciple grants immense power, protection, and prestige.

The sixth major realm of Ki Refining, achieved after successfully overcoming the Heavenly Tribulation and transcending the Five Elements. An Earth Immortal possesses a Golden Lotus soul-vessel and effectively limitless longevity within their home realm.

The seventh major realm of Ki Refining; a being who has not only transcended mortality but fully unified with a Heavenly Dao. They possess nigh-infinite power and serve as the backbone of immortal empires like the Grand Xia.

A supremely powerful class of artificial construct, forged by puppet grandmasters using Dao matrices. The top-tier version described here can single-handedly dominate battlefields against dozens of Celestial Immortals.
A self-enforcing cosmic vow invoked by cultivators. Breaking it triggers instant punishment from the universal laws of karma, making it one of the few guarantees that transcend mortal trust.
A form of cosmic credit accumulated through virtuous deeds, visible to advanced cultivators as a golden aura. It influences reincarnation and can protect against certain soul-based attacks.

The fifth major realm of Ki Refining. At this stage, the cultivator’s nascent soul matures into a full Primal soul, granting telepathic powers (divine sense), the ability to manifest external avatars, and dramatically extended lifespan.

A cultivator who failed to transcend the Heavenly Tribulation but survived, preserving their life as a soul-bound immortal. Loose Immortals are extremely powerful but cursed with periodic tribulations that grow harsher over time.

A weapon imbued with the power of an immortal’s Dao, classified as a graded treasure above Mortal, Earth, and Heaven ranks. Supreme-grade Immortal-ranked blades are among the finest weapons available to cultivators below the True God level.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why does Mu Northson refuse to tell Ji Ning the truth at first?
cultural_notes_faq.a: He is terrified of dragging his senior brother into the same nightmare. He has already lost Yu Xia; he cannot bear to be the cause of Ji Ning’s ruin as well.

cultural_notes_faq.q: How does Ji Ning prove he is now a Daofather’s disciple?
cultural_notes_faq.a: He reveals a thousand supreme-grade Immortal-ranked flying swords—an obscene wealth no ordinary cultivator could possess—and demonstrates a flawless shape-shifting technique that even replicates the target’s aura and karma.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What is the Heavenly Dao oath mentioned by the general?
cultural_notes_faq.a: It is a self-enforcing cosmic vow sworn on the universal laws themselves. Breaking it invites instant annihilation, which is why the captive puppet masters can trust it as a genuine promise of release after a thousand years.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What are these puppets capable of?
cultural_notes_faq.a: The strongest Divine Fiend Puppet, in the hands of a single Celestial Immortal, can overpower ten or even a hundred Celestial Immortals fighting together. Even the second-tier puppets grant Loose Immortals the combat power of a full Celestial Immortal.
